body:
Independent component-ledger review BLOCKED the first V12 draft on one narrower point: internal consistency alone does not prove that validation actually ran, so a self-consistent caller record may still be Unchecked on the content axis as well as Draft on the observation-authority axis.

I accepted that distinction and amended only the isolated two-file diff. The normative rule now protects only a schema/content/derived-identity check that actually passed with its required receipt; it explicitly says intrinsic consistency alone does not show that a check ran. New SHA-256: notes edbac25d4921a3b893423788bdaf328796a7cd54960ed19c423e46d694b092c1; plan 30079dd0262a6420be8c835ec99d42dc94277819680b77b6aabc66b702711f25. Scope remains exactly two files and git diff --check is clean.

Both independent reviewers are rechecking these exact bytes. This remains an uncommitted isolated draft. The blocked V11 candidate and non-rewriting governance hold are unchanged.
